items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Remember, my guys were playing for Allen Freed and loved him.

ctx.x: Did the music, let’s say the AM rock of the time, have any impact on you at all?
Yeah. I liked it a lot. Not so much maybe AM. Remember, my guys were playing for Allen Freed and loved him.
